name: Dishan
title: Horite tribal father in Seir
summary: Dishan was one of the Horite tribal chiefs (clan leaders) in the mountains of Seir, in the area that later became known as Edom. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as a son of Seir the Horite. His descendants were among the original inhabitants of the land before Esau's offspring took over the region.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as a son of Se'ir
keyEvents.description: Disjan is listed as one of Seir's sons, tribal chiefs among the Horites who lived in the mountains of Seir.

keyEvents.title: The Sons of Disjan
keyEvents.description: Disjan's sons are mentioned as Uz and Aran, who were his descendants and continued his clan.

keyEvents.title: Tribal Chiefs of the Horites
keyEvents.description: Disjan is counted among the Horite tribal chiefs in the region of Edom, which was the land of the original inhabitants of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Disjan's lineage and his sons Uz and Aran are repeated in the genealogy in Chronicles, confirming his place in the line of Seir.
